title: Dungeon Crawler Carl — First Floor

regionStatusLegend.visited: The story shows Carl and Donut at this place.
regionStatusLegend.visited_route: A traversed route or connected regional space.
regionStatusLegend.visited_sub_location: A part or state of a larger location.

regions.label: Dungeon entrance and Kua-tin threshold
regions.description: Broad carved descent to a marble landing and enormous arched Kua-tin doors. Beyond them, the first-floor route begins; exact chamber dimensions are unknown.

regions.label: False Tutorial Guild alley
regions.description: A misleading neon guild sign leads into the goblin Murder Dozer ambush. The alley and trap are one encounter sequence, not two separate destinations.

regions.label: Mordecai’s Tutorial Guildhall
regions.description: The real Tutorial Guild entrance opens to Mordecai’s personal tutorial space, with a classroom and living area. Mordecai is a guide and NPC here, not a deployable party member.

regions.label: Torchlit arteries and neighborhood passages
regions.description: A compact playable abstraction of the branching rock-hewn grid. Broad torchlit arteries connect neighborhoods; some side passages use dark red brick and green growth. This is a connector region, not a claim about exact route geometry.

objective.label: Map a route through the First Floor

subregions.label: Creature territories (unmapped)
subregions.notes: Creature/area labels, not official district names. Neighborhood order and boundaries are inferred.

regions.label: Hoarder’s lair / Scatterer nest
regions.description: A round, high-ceiling room among rubbish piles and burst bags, with a grimy signed door and skull torches. The Scatterer territory belongs to this lair complex.

regions.label: Tally’s Polish restaurant safe room
regions.description: A Polish fast-food restaurant repurposed as a protected safe room. The children’s play area is inside this same venue. Exact chain branding and layout are not established.

regions.label: Goblin workshop and adjoining boss chamber
regions.description: A goblin engineering and explosives workshop connected to the War Chieftain’s chamber. Workshop equipment is an adaptation of its stated use; exact machinery and room plan are not canonical.

regions.label: DMV waiting-room safe room
regions.description: An Earth DMV waiting room used as a safe room, with curtained cots and an experience-cookie encounter associated with Frank and Maggie.

regions.label: Juicer’s gym
regions.description: A high-ceiling gym with sliding glass entry, reception turnstile, weights, benches and mats. Red combat lighting is part of the encounter presentation.

regions.label: Ball of Swine spiral maze and stairwell
regions.description: Rounded tunnels spiral around a courtyard, with portcullises and three bridge approaches. The final boss encounter reveals the arena and its stairwell. The switch chamber and Speedbump construction area are subregions/states, not separate destinations.

objective.label: Resolve the Ball of Swine boss encounter

regions.label: Rest-stop reports at the guild
regions.description: The guide or crawlers mention an Alabama Waffle House and a candy-vending rest area. This is a report/rumor interaction at the Tutorial Guild, not a physical map destination; neither place is established as a Carl visit.

objective.label: Hear reports of other rest stops

regions.label: Meadow Lark encampment
regions.description: A survivor encampment near the borough-boss stairwell. Treat its footprint as an authored camp layout; sources establish the camp and proximity, not a canonical settlement plan.

regions.label: Sebastian’s Peruvian Taco Bell safe room
regions.description: A converted restaurant safe room with kitchen, sleeping area, bathrooms, coffee, and Peruvian beer. Exact room layout is not established.

adaptationNote: Playable region graph, objective gates, positions, and all inter-region connections are game-authored inferred connectivity. Canon evidence establishes places and a broad sequence but no complete First Floor plan. This is a practical route abstraction, not an exhaustive atlas; the 36 concept panels include views, subregions, mentioned leads, and reusable generic concepts. Only encounterIds point to existing game-content scenarios, whose combat rules and timelines are adaptations. The story’s Floor 1 cast is Carl and Donut with other crawlers encountered as the text supports; the runtime’s optional party roster must not imply Katia’s Floor 1 involvement. Mordecai is a nondeployable guide. Floor 3-only class unlocks are outside this floor.
